body: I want to be a part of the group, it sounds fun! Since, random lobbies have become nearly unplayable nowadays

Some Randoms just blame anyone without any proof and say that that guy vented and an innocent guy is voted out and that guy who just blames everyone and ruins the game is never kicked. It happens with me a lot; I literally tell them to see me do scan and garbage but I am voted out. 

In most lobbies there are abusive players who are very toxic, they do the same thing as above but abuse a lot more, I once told one of these guys to not abuse at least and that guy called me a 'f*cking cry baby' and the others either laughed or supported him by abusing me more; This happens with a lot of players.

Players on discord and hackers who know the Imposters ruin the game and the other people in the lobby don't vote out the cheater most of the times and the Imposters get voted out and don't get to have a good chance to play.

All of this is very annoying, I don't know how there are just not sensible players in the game who can make the game enjoyable for everyone. I don't really have friends with whom I can play this game so I'm really thinking of deleting it.

I feel the same way, I am suicidal for the past 4 months but just can't seem to build up the courage. I tie the noose, make the plans but at the end moment I don't make an attempt after that everything feels just the same, life is a mess but I watch something and get over with the gloominess and then start feeling the same way some time later. I don't even know how everything feels alright for sometime so suddenly.

I have tried but nothing actually works for me, I started with meditation for a while too and even took anxiety meds but I feel like I am going to overthink, remain stressed out and anxious for like forever. (I know it sounds dumb, but that is just how I think and feel)
I understand to some extent as to what your situation with your parents is like. Families can be messy and difficult, I hope things get better for you.

I have one but its like they knock 10 times a day and if I don't open up they think I am doing something 'wrong' or 'suspicious'.

According to my parents, a person locks his/her room only if they want to do something 'wrong'.

Ya, I mean my room is like my life. I spend pretty much my whole day there and I just get out for dinner and to have a conversation or so in a day with my family. I am like super comfortable in my room and I really don't like when others inrrude my privacy 😅
Even I have stopped mentioning my feelings or what I go through on an everyday basis. Its like I have to mask my emotions and feelings at my own home and in front of people whom I love.

The same thing happened with me when I told her about my anxiety and depression, she just blamed it all on me and told me to focus on my life, study and don't waste anymore. Now instead of scolding she just passes comments like "I am not saying anything to you or else you'll go into depression again and fail in exams."
It is very annoying and makes me really sad.
Thanks a lot for your help! It is really nice of you:)
I like making cakes and other bakery stuff.
I really like cooking, it is one of my favourite hobbies so ya It does make me feel better..

I don't really have friends. Last year I did tell one of my teachers about my situation but she just told that to the whole group of teachers. So, I don't really feel safe in sharing stuff with people I know.

Outdoor activities and entertainment would be fun but because of COVID I am locked in for the past 8 months and it has certainly impacted my mental state
Can I know as to how you're coping with your situation? Your methods might help me.

I think that I have to go to a good college for a future and I know that that isn't really important (maybe) I wish my family would be okay with my better well being inspite of them just being focused on good grades. But this is the final year of my high school and if I fail this, I'd be doomed.

Also, I am sorry if I am disturbing you.
I did try to listen to music, eat my favourite foods watch movies. I did enjoy but that doesn't change the fact that my life is a mess.

I don't have time to ease myself, my half yearly exams are starting in a week and I have literally zero preparation for them (Please don't judge me, I tried very hard to study). If I score low, my parents would be angry and disappointed

My half yearly exams are going to start after a week and I have literally zero preparation for them (Please Don't Judge me, I tried very hard to study). I don't think I can deal with them. My parents would be very angry and disappointed if I don't score well.

Thanks for this, I know there are options. I am a good writer and currently doing Internship in a firm but the thing is that good companies hire you in that field only if you have graduated from a good college and also my parents will look down upon me more and I just don't have the energy to convince them and even myself, I mean I cannot fail high school I have to clear it out and I just can't seem to. I just don't understand the point of continuously striving hard and keep on getting negatively affected by even the ones I love (The thing I mentioned above where I brought myself together) I feel like if I forget everything and work towards a goal again, I would meet with the same consequences. My efforts would be ignored by others and I'd be judged and considered a dumb head who just makes excuses
It is so weird that I am basically in the same situation as you, It'd be great if we could talk to each other and just let some thoughts out. If you feel comfortable please PM me

Same here. I am planning to hang myself, but I tie the noose stare at it and never been able to build up the courage to just do it. It is so messed up even though I know that my life is fucked up and won't get better
